text:
Maya K: Heads up — finalizing panel for Wed 3pm PT. Quick confirmations: timezone ok, recording+transcript consent, and accessibility (captions). Calendar currently Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/123456789

Samir P: can't do 3pm PT — I have an overlapping sync. I can swap with Jordan if we keep 3pm. @Jordan R can you cover 3pm?

Jordan R: I can cover 3pm, but prefer 2:30. Either works.

Priya S: 3pm is fine for me. Please enable live captions and send transcript to candidate file share. Also would like the scoring rubric clarified for system-design (weighting).

Maya K: noted on captions. HR confirmed recording & transcript is OK with candidate. I'll turn on captions. Rubric: should we use the standard weights or adjust for system design?

Jordan R: propose weights: ```
Technical correctness: 60
Architecture/Design: 30
Communication: 10
```

Samir P: I'm fine with that. Small ask: can we have debrief scribe? I need to step out 10 mins after session.

Maya K: @Samir P can scribe? or @Priya S? I can but will be running panel.

Priya S: I can scribe. I'll capture scores in the debrief doc and paste notes.

Maya K: thanks. Quick calendar notes: set `join before host` = off, require registration = off, host mute on entry = yes. Invite text will include: "Live captions enabled, recording/transcript permitted."

Ops Bot: meeting updated — captions ON, recording allowed, transcript saved to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/example-panel-Wed

Jordan R: small config for interviewer tool: please disable participant screen share to avoid accidental presentation.

Maya K: done. Final: I'll update invite and post final here. Ping me ASAP if swap needed. :thumbsup:
